profile.title: AI Chatbot Developer | Next.js | React Node.js | Nextjs Full Stack
profile.description:
I am a Senior Next.js Developer focused on React, Node.js, and API-driven web applications.

My main work is building custom web products where the frontend depends on clean architecture, reliable API integration, authentication, and real user workflows. I usually work on Next.js / React applications connected to existing backends, Node.js services, REST or GraphQL APIs, Firebase, CMS tools, and third-party integrations.

I can help when you need a React developer or front-end developer who can do more than just build UI screens. I can take Figma designs, Bootstrap themes, existing prototypes, or legacy interfaces and turn them into production-ready Next.js / React pages connected to real data and backend logic.

I also support full-stack Next.js and MERN-stack products when the project uses React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, or a similar JavaScript-based stack. My backend work usually covers API integration, authentication flows, account logic, dashboards, ecommerce flows, admin panels, and integration with external services.

Earlier in my career, I worked with WordPress, CMS-based websites, and classic web development projects. That experience helped me understand content structure, SEO-friendly pages, admin workflows, landing pages, and business websites. Today, my focus is custom development: Next.js applications, React frontends, full-stack Next.js products, SaaS platforms, ecommerce flows, marketplaces, customer portals, and web applications built around real product logic.

Typical projects I can help with:
- Next.js and React web application development
- full-stack Next.js development with Node.js and Express.js
- React developer / front-end developer work for existing products
- REST API and GraphQL API integration
- Firebase, Firestore, and Google Cloud Platform integrations
- NextAuth and custom authentication flows
- SaaS dashboards, customer portals, marketplaces, and ecommerce platforms
- Strapi, headless CMS, and CMS-driven web products
- Figma-to-Next.js or Bootstrap-to-Next.js implementation
- frontend architecture, performance improvements, and code maintainability

Tech I work with:
Next.js, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, RESTful API, GraphQL, Firebase, Firestore, Google Cloud Platform, NextAuth, Redux, Strapi, CMS integrations.

I am comfortable joining an existing team, working directly with a CTO or founder, taking ownership of a product area, and moving features from backlog to release.

profile.title: QuickBooks ProAdvisor & Bookkeeper | US Nonresident & Expat Tax
profile.description:
US-based tax preparer and QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor. I work the US tax cases most preparers avoid: nonresidents with US income, US citizens living abroad, and foreign owners of US companies. This is year-round work, not just an April rush.

Cross-border tax: Forms 1040-NR for nonresidents, the foreign earned income exclusion (2555) and foreign tax credit (1116) for expats, and the foreign-owned and foreign-corporation returns 5471, 5472, and FBAR. A missed 5472 alone is a $25,000 penalty, so these get filed right.

US returns and small business: individual 1040, partnership 1065, and corporate 1120 and 1120-S, including returns on extension and quarterly estimated taxes.

Bookkeeping for small US businesses: QuickBooks Online setup and cleanup, transaction categorization, bank and credit card reconciliations, and monthly financial summaries, so your books are accurate and tax-ready before next season.

Credentials: QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor, Intuit Bookkeeping certified, and IRS Annual Filing Season Program participant. Based in the US, so you work in your own time zone with someone who files US returns every season.

Tell me your situation in a sentence and I will tell you which forms apply and what it costs.

I also build Angular and web applications, so ask if you need development work.
